name: Fixedvowelconsonantinversion

description_json.name: FixedVowelConsonantInversion
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable substitution cipher that swaps vowels with vowels and consonants with consonants using a fixed, easy-to-compute mapping. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are reversed (A<->U, E<->O, I<->I). Consonants are paired up and swapped in a fixed, simple manner (B<->Z, C<->Y, D<->X, F<->W, G<->V, H<->T, J<->S, K<->R, L<->P, M<->N, Q<->P is not used, instead we pair the remaining: P<->Q). This is symmetric, case-preserving, and leaves non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is a vowel, swap it using the vowel mapping: A<->U, E<->O, I<->I (and their uppercase equivalents).
2. If it is a consonant, swap it using the fixed consonant mapping: B<->Z, C<->Y, D<->X, F<->W, G<->V, H<->T, J<->S, K<->R, L<->P, M<->N, P<->Q (and their uppercase equivalents).
3. If it is a space, digit, punctuation, or any other non-alphabetic character, leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Because the mapping is completely symmetric, applying the exact same encryption rules to the ciphertext will restore the original plaintext.

This is symmetric, case-preserving, and leaves non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged.

Cipher definition:
-encryption: For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is a vowel, swap it using the vowel mapping: A<->U, E<->O, I<->I (and their uppercase equivalents).

3. If it is a space, digit, punctuation, or any other non-alphabetic character, leave it unchanged.
